purpose: Committed reference floors for the bar-calibration guard in scripts/check_evidence_contract.py. A preregistered leakage bar must cite one of these ids and must not sit below the floor it cites. Three bars have already failed by being set below what reality achieves; this file exists so the fourth cannot be written without the checker seeing the floor.

metric_definition.negative_selection_caveat: Concentration moves with the negative set: same-domain hard negatives give ~1.76-2.03x on human corpora, random-corpus negatives ~3.70x on the SAME sets. Absolute target coverage is the more robust headline; a concentration bar is only comparable to a floor measured with the same negative selection.

floors.unit_definition: one repo-memory event (a single mined coding-attempt event body) as the memory unit; question authored to be maximally abstracted while remaining answerable and uniquely identifying
floors.recorded_roughness: small sample, single generator model wrote every probe question, uniqueness agent-judged; an order-of-magnitude floor, not a constant

shape_dependence.consequence: a shape-uniform bar is itself a defect

floors.unit_definition: human-authored coding query against a single code/issue/review unit; same-domain hard negatives
floors.applies_only_to: human-authored coding queries; this band must NOT be reused across unit definitions

rows.instrument: swe-prbench public_human_review, put through OUR pipeline
rows.note: A published human corpus, measured with our own tokenizer and same-domain hard negatives, FAILED our preregistered <= 2.05x gate. This row is the reason the bar guard rejects any `le` bar that a recorded human corpus cannot pass.

floors.provenance_binding: Supplied by the owner and NOT reproduced by this repo. Cited as calibration only, never re-reported as a MemPhant measurement. Recorded at docs/build-log/2026-07-31-track-r-paraphrase-bar.md:399-406.

historical_bar_failures.outcome: preregistered below the measured floor; the paraphrase bank recorded bar_passed=false at 2.018x while sitting inside the human band
